description: Freeze-protection sprinklers on the strawberries (December to February); drip irrigation and fertigation at the Home Farm; River Field pivot irrigation for peanuts (May to September); alarms and schedules in the SYS-01 irrigation module
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Freeze-season values: sprinklers must be running before the field temperature reaches the critical level, so the farm has about 2 hours from the freeze alarm. One missed freeze night can lose the U-pick crop (about $70,000). Outside freeze season the MTD is 48 hours (peanuts tolerate 2 days without irrigation). RPO of 24 hours: schedules and setpoints can be re-entered from the previous day's settings
source_evidence: EV-034 (owner BIA worksheet); EV-004 (alarm path and remote control); EV-009 and EV-010 (manual switches); EV-007 (vendor RTO 8 hours); EV-024 and EV-012 (strawberry crop value)
manual_workaround: Switch the pump controller and pivot panel to local and Hand; start the freeze sprinkler zone by hand from the pump house; check a standalone thermometer in the field every hour on forecast freeze nights; run the pivot by hand at its panel
dependent_third_parties: FMIS vendor; irrigation dealer; internet provider; cellular carrier; electric utility
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-operator (single point of failure, must be on site); pump house; well

description: Online U-pick time-slot reservations with prepayment; farm stand and online pre-orders; card reader payments; customer emails and the farm website
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: In season a closed weekend loses about $4,000 and customers book elsewhere; reservations are held by the booking vendor, so the farm can lose at most a day of manual changes
source_evidence: EV-034 (owner BIA worksheet); EV-012 (about $4,000 per in-season weekend); EV-011 (reservations held by the vendor)
manual_workaround: Post a notice on the farm's social page; take walk-in customers first-come first-served; accept cash or the card reader in offline mode; keep a printed list of the weekend's reservations each Friday
dependent_third_parties: Booking platform vendor; card processor; email marketing service

description: SYS-01 field and pesticide application records; qualified exemption sales records and annual review (21 CFR 112.7); crop insurance acreage and production records; FSA acreage reports; NRCS contract records; water use totals
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Records are needed on request rather than every day, so a few days of downtime is tolerable. Loss is the real harm: without sales records the farm cannot show it is eligible for the qualified exemption (112.7(b)), and without production records a crop insurance claim can fail. RPO of 24 hours is not supported today: SYS-01 has never been exported and the files have no version history
source_evidence: EV-034 (owner BIA worksheet); EV-005 (no SYS-01 export); EV-016 (no file version history); EV-023 (exemption sales records); EV-027 (program records)
manual_workaround: Paper copies of program documents in the home office; buying point settlement sheets and booking platform reports can be re-requested from the counterparties
dependent_third_parties: FMIS vendor; booking platform vendor; accounting SaaS vendor; crop insurance agent; buying point

description: Deciding digging dates from maturity checks and the yield map; scheduling the custom harvest operator; deliveries and settlement at the buying point (September to October)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Dug peanuts must be combined within a few days and weather windows are short; most of the work is physical and phone calls, so the systems matter less than the owner and the custom operator
source_evidence: EV-034 (owner BIA worksheet); EV-025 (buying point settlement); EV-019 (custom harvest invoices)
manual_workaround: Phone the custom operator and the buying point; use paper maturity notes; the buying point issues paper settlement sheets
dependent_third_parties: Custom harvest operator; buying point; crop insurance agent

description: Bookkeeping; paying the custom operator, landowner, and suppliers; online banking; taxes (Schedule F); email; USDA program paperwork
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deadlines are measured in days; the cost risk is payment fraud (a fake invoice or changed bank details), not downtime. RPO of 24 hours is not supported for files in SYS-02 because version history is off
source_evidence: EV-034 (owner BIA worksheet); EV-017 (bank payee code); EV-019 (payments arranged by email); EV-016 (no file version history)
manual_workaround: Pay by check; call the bank branch; paper copies of the lease and program contracts in the home office
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS vendor; bank; tax preparer
